    2027 Adult Lap Swim Waiver

    Sign once per season. Each adult in the household signs for themselves.

    1. Adults only during lap swim hours (teen policy set by the board).
    2. No lifeguard is on duty; I swim at my own risk.
    3. Buddy required. I will never swim alone, and I'll leave if my buddy leaves.
    4. I won't share the gate code and will close the gate behind me.
